newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Hang Seng Bank rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hang Seng Bank rated sell.

text.p: Bear Stearns Asia Ltd analyst Thomas Monaco has initiated coverage of Hang Seng Bank Ltd with a sell rating, the company said on Tuesday.
Hang Seng Bank, a 61.5 percent held subsidiary of HSBC Holdings Plc, is trading at a large premium to its historical average by several standards of measurement, Monaco said.
"The share was trading at an excessive valuation based on fundamentals, the changing dynamics of the Hong Kong mortgage market and industry-wide trade finance problems," the report said.
Monaco also reported there was no basis for earlier speculation that the Bank of China would be interested in a takeover of Hang Seng Bank.
